FN-ODCNMJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 195
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/17/2023
Senate Bill 195 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Legislature by an
undetermined amount, dependent on the increase in per diem and travel expenses to be paid for
the addition of two members to the Contract Review Permanent Legislative Oversight
Committee. The estimated travel expense minimum for two additional members for a one day
meeting is $353; however, this rate would increase up to $498 per member if the meeting
requires overnight accommodations to be made.
Page 1

FN-ODCNMJ-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 195
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/28/2023
Senate Bill 195 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Legislature by an
estimated range of $500 to $1,000 per meeting of the Contract Review Permanent Legislative
Oversight Committee for per diem and travel expenses of two additional members of the
committee, as provided by this bill.
